results: Presentation context: selecting L06 activates the existing single Spatial Card while remaining in the live Presentation UI.
Explore activation: compact bottom-right controller appears with one OYI shortcut and no duplicate Ask Oyi bar.
Pointer hold: holding Forward moves the real camera in the WebGL viewport; release clears movement.
Keyboard: W movement uses the same Explore movement contract and moves the WebGL viewport.
OYI shortcut: opens the existing contextual Oyi surface without adding a second top search.
Interact: center button executes through the app-level canonical target/selection handler; no detached fake modal appears.
Exit: hides controller, clears movement, and W is ignored when Explore is inactive.
Escape: exits Explore mode through the same cleanup path.
